scope: Final native registered-compiler / Scratch VM / RobotLab / virtual SPIKE / unchanged native physics qualification of the exact delivered complete freestanding main and real-brace control, using the identical program. No app installation, browser or hardware qualification.
predeclarationBasis: Original unchanged gates reject browser source85fb0dcaa: upper held span4.789185 degrees is below5. A separate predeclared diagnostic compared outward speeds30/15 with unchanged180 return at25ms and33.333ms VM cadence. Select30, which passed all four main/control/cadence cases; preserve both original failure and all diagnostic attempts. This final app adaptation must independently pass its native and real-browser runs.

measurement.cold: First 0.5 seconds unpowered, before motor hold or any VM command. Saved crank and both links point down.
measurement.angles: Measure each actual body-carried saved link direction in the current frame source-XY basis; unwrap about source+Z. Elbow is measured lower minus upper. Motor encoder sign is separate from source-axis sign.
measurement.heldWindow: The VM observing flag defines the 12-second post-return support-hold period; motion analysis excludes its first0.25seconds. Quantify actual crank and top-pivot stationarity, not only the encoder.
measurement.spans: Maximum minus minimum over the declared window for independent measured upper, lower and elbow angles. Final3seconds use the end of the same held window.
measurement.pivotTravel: Maximum Euclidean displacement from the first analyzed held sample in world and frame coordinates, reported separately.
measurement.reversals: Elbow direction changes require at least0.25degree accumulated excursion; this is a motion diagnostic, not a measured natural frequency or chaos test.
measurement.closure: Independently carry both original compiled hinge anchors and axes by each owner body; measure all actual hinges including any retained pin-spin hinge.
measurement.frame: Actual world displacement and tilt of the frame from saved native pose; no frame body is fixed. Bottom-foot signed distances use the actual compiled ground box top plane.
measurement.control: Same complete model and same program, plus six real brace pieces. Both link parts must share a rigid owner and have at most0.1degree relative motion while the braced pendulum moves. Original elbow frictionless pin can retain an independent free-spin body. No artificial fixed joint or numerical angle substitution.
measurement.controlConfound: Brace changes mass and inertia along with eliminating the relative elbow degree of freedom. Do not claim mass-matched frequency, damping or energy attribution, or manufacture a ratio by dividing by structuralzero.

evidenceRules: Snapshot exact inputs before each attempt. Preserve failed attempts and outcomes.
Freeze matching final model/config/program hashes before full-VM qualification.
A changed requirement, observer or executable input requires a separately identified contract/config and rerun; never relabel a failed run.
Qualification covers recorded native samples and exact declared static/swept geometry scopes; physical build and app/browser remain UNTESTED.
At completion the motor support stays held; passive links may continue moving.
author: CrispStrobe
revisionReason: Keep all original numerical output/closure/ground/support limits and geometry. Slow outward motion reduces sensitivity to VM-cadence-dependent impulse cancellation; return remains fast. Original full-browser failure is preserved; fresh native and both browser engines are required.
